name: David McAllister - Après le § 34 - Am 23
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 34e. Rejects the ‘Trump norm’ that asks NATO countries to invest 5 % of their GDP in their military budgets; rejects the Commission’s EUR 800 billion Readiness 2030 plan, which will divert public funds from social and civilian programmes to arms multinationals; notes that such drastic military investment will increase Europe’s dependency on the US military industry;
